page.overview:
Who is D. D. Tee?

The Giant Warrior Pirates is a pirate crew made up of giants from Elbaph lead by Dorry and Brogy. Before them, the crew's captains were Jarul and Jorul. They disbanded 102 years ago when Dorry and Brogy began their duel, but reunited once they returned to Elbaph. They are major allies of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Egghead Arc.

During Dorry and Brogy's absence, Hajrudin formed a spiritual revival crew, the New Giant Warrior Pirates, who are a part of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet.

The Giant Warrior Pirates' Jolly Roger is completely black, consisting of a skull with a helmet with two horns, and with two crossed swords underneath. The design is adapted in the New Giant Warrior Pirates' Jolly Roger.

Additionally, two more members named ティー|Dī Dī Tī}} and have been mentioned, but their exact identities are unclear.
